title: otites nutans
intro: Otites nutans, commonly known as the ear-drop plant or ear-flower, is a flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. It is a parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the roots of the host plant, commonly found in tropical Africa. The health benefits of Otites nutans include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Otites nutans include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties.
